scenarios.title: Add PEP (Politically Exposed Person) flag to customer accounts
scenarios.prompt: Add a new PEP classification flag to the customer_accounts domain. This needs to flow from Oracle DWH through to the mart_customer_360 table and be included in regulatory exposure reports.

impact.reason: Regulatory field addition affects Basel III/IV reporting and PRA returns

acceptance_criteria: PEP flag available in mart_customer_360 within 24hrs of source update
Regulatory exposure report includes PEP-flagged customers
No regression in existing query performance

scenarios.title: Migrate FX Rates domain from Oracle to Iceberg
scenarios.prompt: Migrate the FX rates real-time market data feeds from Oracle DWH to the Iceberg lakehouse. This includes intraday spot rates, forward rates, and historical EOD rates. Must maintain sub-second query latency for the trading desk.

impact.reason: Trading desk latency SLA; FCA market data requirements; dual-run reconciliation needed

regression_tests: Existing domains unaffected by new streaming job
performance_tests: Sub-second P99 query latency with 50 concurrent users
Streaming lag < 30 seconds for spot rates
acceptance_criteria: Trading desk sign-off on query latency

scenarios.title: Fix timestamp precision drift in transaction reconciliation
scenarios.prompt: Reconciliation is failing for the transactions domain. The Parquet writer is truncating timestamps to millisecond precision but Oracle stores microseconds. This causes a mismatch in the dual-run comparison for 0.3% of records.

impact.reason: Blocking dual-run sign-off; 10-day reconciliation window cannot start until fixed

unit_tests: Microsecond precision preserved in Parquet write
integration_tests: Full reconciliation pass with microsecond timestamps
No data loss during precision upgrade
acceptance_criteria: No performance regression in streaming pipeline

scenarios.title: Add new data quality checks for IBAN format compliance
scenarios.prompt: Compliance has flagged that 2% of customer account IBANs fail ISO 13616 validation. Add Soda checks and Great Expectations rules to catch malformed IBANs at ingestion time and quarantine bad records.

impact.reason: PRA/FCA compliance requirement; malformed IBANs affect payment processing

unit_tests: IBAN checksum validation for GB, DE, FR, IE formats
regression_tests: No false positives on valid IBANs

scenarios.title: Onboard counterparty data domain to lakehouse
scenarios.prompt: Onboard the Counterparty Data domain (500K+ institutional counterparties) from Oracle to the Iceberg lakehouse. This is a new domain that has not yet been migrated. It includes LEI codes, credit ratings, and exposure limits.

impact.reason: LEI codes critical for Basel III/IV counterparty credit risk; exposure limits for trading

integration_tests: Full pipeline Oracle → Iceberg → Trino queryable
regression_tests: No impact on existing 3 domain pipelines
performance_tests: Query performance acceptable for risk team

evaluation_dataset.description: Ground truth dataset for evaluating classification and impact analysis accuracy

metrics.classification_accuracy: Expected primary delivery type matches actual
metrics.confidence_calibration: Predicted confidence correlates with actual accuracy
metrics.risk_level_accuracy: Predicted risk matches actual operational risk
